about: SCION 23 geometry tests, measured in the runtime (skeleton cm; at the wide camera 1 cm = 1.9 px, at the closest 3.08 px). They test the representation; whether it reads is for the critic.

bone_length_under_IK.meaning: link length after mixing + IK minus the link length the mixed pose asks for

bone_length_under_mixing.meaning: outside the two turn clips, link length vs the bind length of the body view on screen (0 or 135 deg), for the links clips never re-key (lower legs, paws, chest, neck, tail tip)

feet_planted.meaning: paw joint world motion between consecutive frames while planted and IK mix 1

ik_reach.meaning: planner target vs reached paw joint

lowest_joint.meaning: skeleton plane y of the lowest joint (0 = floor at the dog's depth; near-side joints sit up to -2 cm lower on screen by the camera tilt)

head_below_back_on_approach.meaning: ear base (top of skull) minus chest joint + 14 cm (top of the back at the withers), over the whole approach 14.708-23.75 s; negative = head below the back
